cells.gaps: No fact counts the hospitals or offices using the e-birth registry of 2026; the newest offices fact, KEN-014 for 2023, reports no office entering digitally, and predates the system. KEN-002 has parents entering the data in the hospital and does not say the entry is made at a registration office; systems.csv carries the same system as an e-notification processed at the civil registration office. Deaths are not on the system. No plan is held for the period: KEN-023's ran 2018 to 2022.
cells.note: More than 270,000 births were registered in two months through the digital solution, with data going directly to the population registry, which is rung 3 with offices not published. The fact's words do not say the entry is made at the office, so it reaches no rung above 3, and no share or count with a denominator is held.
